items.title: Adelic base-change homeomorphism with the complete local, tensor and restricted-product construction
authors: Imperial FLT project contributors; original individual file Authors headers retained
items.difficulty_reason: H2 is attached to this complete authored construction, not the188-190 terminal definition alone. Local completion surjectivity uses density plus a closed finite-dimensional range. The integral-image construction431-479 chooses an integral basis, lifts each basis element to B and explicitly builds the tensor preimage of an open product neighborhood;535-547 and854-868 identify its integral image. TensorPi199-270 constructs the finite-presentation/five-lemma witness, including product exactness and coordinate preimages. TensorRestrictedProduct113-161 explicitly builds the principal-filter inverse;172-225 transports it through compatible direct limits and checks the actual tensor map. Finite-adeles205-211 composes the four real maps and336-365 establishes the module topology, before the global L-algebra homeomorphism. These matched integral/topological and filter/tensor constructions remain after ordinary finite-field, ramification and module-theory priors. Comparison824-838 and additive compactness788-791 are context only, not additional counted conclusions.
